title: Data Science & Generative AI: From Python to Transformers
description: From your first Python variable through pandas, statistics, classical machine learning and PyTorch to fine-tuning a transformer. Ends with three timed mock assessments: build a dashboard or a model in 50 minutes with a GenAI assistant, then mark both your code and your chat transcript. IN PROGRESS: Module 1 (Python fundamentals, 11 lessons) and Module 9 (mock assessments) built; Modules 2-8 planned.
author: Vinod Seth
